title: RAGE | It Holds His Fists
description:
Every time he lost his temper, the shadow on the kitchen wall grew a little taller. Tonight he was the one watching his little brother, and his little brother was the one learning.

RAGE | It Holds His Fists is an animated short film about the temper that grows every time you feed it, and the morning he finally opened his hands.

What do you do in the three seconds before you snap? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #horror #selfimprovement #anger
